text:
Maya (sec-eng): Quick pulse — SOC2 fieldwork next week. Need to confirm KMS ownership for rotation evidence and auditlog ingestion. Sharing current gaps: PR #4723 blocked, evidence zip not updated, runbook missing rotation timestamps. Who can ack ownership?
Rob (eng-infra): I'll own KMS rotation evidence. Can someone paste the PR link and runbook path? @Lina do we have CI job pushing audit logs to staging S3?
Lina (platform): CI job exists but was disabled after last infra change. Re-enabling now, ETA today EOD. Which PR?
Maya (sec-eng): PR is https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/4723 — failing keystore smoke test. Runbook is at /docs/security/kms-rotation.md (draft). Also check retention policy for audit logs — auditors expect 365d.
audit-bot: retention policy currently: `retention_days: 180` for staging (see /configs/audit.yml).
Rob (eng-infra): I can update retention but need approver. @Jared can you sign off? Note: bumping to 365d will increase storage cost.
Jared (product): Approve for compliance. Please add a quick cost estimate first. Rough calc: ~+$120/mo for staging.
Lina (platform): Re-enabling job now. Will add a smoke test and attach logs to the PR. Smoke command I'm running: ```./scripts/smoke_keystore.sh --env=staging```
Maya (sec-eng): For the evidence bundle, please put final zip at s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2026-03-20/kms-rotation.zip — Rob, can you ensure write perms for `redwood-audit-reviewers`?
Rob (eng-infra): Yep. Adding bucket ACL change in infra (terraform) — will open PR #4728.
Lina (platform): Quick note on HSM: staging uses softHSM simulator. Fieldwork needs that clearly called out in evidence. I'll add README to the bundle.
Maya (sec-eng): Add a short key provenance statement to the runbook as well. Auditors will want a one-liner about generation and logging.
Rob (eng-infra): Draft provenance line: "Customer envelope keys are generated in HSM-backed KMS with provenance logged to our audit stream; staging uses softHSM for smoke tests." I'll paste into runbook PR.
Jared (product): Product wants a short blurb for CISO: "Rotation cadence: 90 days; emergency rotation documented."
Maya (sec-eng): Outstanding asks: 1) Lina attach smoke logs to PR 4723; 2) Rob open infra PR 4728 for bucket ACL + retention; 3) Lina add HSM note to evidence zip. Assign and ETA?
Lina (platform): Taking 1+3. ETA today 5pm PT.
Rob (eng-infra): Taking 2. ETA tomorrow 10am PT. Will @mention audit-bot when done.
audit-bot: Reminder scheduled: `Reminder: upload evidence bundle by 2026-03-19T22:00:00Z`.
Maya (sec-eng): Reviewers for PRs: @Rob / @Maya. If anything blocks, flag here. :thumbsup:
Lina (platform): Quick heads-up: attaching smoke logs now (will post S3 link in PR). Also noticed a flaky unit in keystore test — adding a comment to PR.
Rob (eng-infra): After ACL + retention PR lands I'll run a validation: ```aws s3api get-bucket-acl --bucket redwood-evidence && aws s3 ls s3://redwood-evidence/soc2/2026-03-20/```
Maya (sec-eng): Thanks all. If we can close these three by tomorrow EOD we'll be in good shape for the fieldwork cut.
Jared (product): Noted. Please ping me if cost or SLA tradeoffs change.
Maya (sec-eng): Closing note — I'll compile an evidence checklist and post to the audit channel once PRs are merged.
Rob (eng-infra): Will follow up with terraform diff in PR description.
Lina (platform): Done on my side, tagging PRs for review.
Maya (sec-eng): :rocket:
